rule: Tolerances are frozen before any native output exists. Discrete transitions (events, spawn/despawn, lane hand-offs, motion direction, signal phases, collision pairs, metric pair identities) are compared exactly under every class; a numeric tolerance never excuses a changed transition.

replay.description: Same build, backend and hardware. Requires byte-identical quantised trace: traceDigest equality plus every discrete and numeric check at zero error.

conformance.description: Cross-language numerical conformance (TypeScript reference vs Rust port, same profile and f64 math). Traces are quantised to 4 decimals for position/speed/s and 6 for heading before hashing; the bound is one quantum above accumulated rounding over a 20 s clip at 50 Hz.
